description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that implements text selection highlighting by adding a style to selected text when the 'styleSelectedText' option is enabled.

methods.name: onCursorActivity
methods.description: Handles cursor activity events to update selection highlighting.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events to clear selection highlights if needed.

methods.name: coverRange
methods.description: Marks a range of text with a specific style.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the selection highlights based on current selections.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the selection highlights based on current cursor positions and selections.
